prompt.project_info: Create a photorealistic vertical supermarket lifestyle portrait that feels candid and everyday, preserving the grey-and-navy athletic outfit, star hair clip and grocery aisle.
prompt.main_subject: One original approved adult woman with dark hair in a casual messy bun, a gold star-shaped hair clip, realistic natural skin and no visible tattoos on the arms. She wears a grey cropped T-shirt with dark navy short sleeves and fitted black athletic leggings. Preserve a natural feminine silhouette without exaggerated measurements or body-part emphasis.
prompt.composition_elements: Vertical 9:16 medium-full shot from the knees upward. The adult subject stands with her back angled toward camera and turns her head over the right shoulder, both hands resting near the waistband. Include metal shelves stocked with generic canned goods and mustard bottles, fluorescent ceiling panels and a second adult shopper in a dark shirt leaning at the left background.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Functional bright overhead fluorescent store lighting with realistic even highlights and candid shadows. Keep the mood ordinary, observational and lightly playful.
prompt.technical_specs: 9:16 vertical smartphone perspective, sharp focus on the main subject, realistic aisle depth and shelf detail, natural skin and fabric texture, restrained candid color; keep package labels small or indistinct.
prompt.generated_prompt_string: Create a photorealistic vertical supermarket lifestyle portrait of one original approved adult woman with dark hair in a casual messy bun, a gold star-shaped hair clip, realistic natural skin and no visible tattoos on the arms. Use a 9:16 medium-full shot from the knees upward; she stands with her back angled toward camera, turns her head over the right shoulder and rests both hands near the waistband. Include metal shelves stocked with generic canned goods and mustard bottles, fluorescent ceiling panels and a second original approved adult shopper in a dark shirt leaning at the left background. Use bright functional overhead fluorescent lighting, realistic aisle depth, natural skin and fabric texture and restrained candid color, with package labels small and indistinct.
